lines: -h, --help            Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
-q, --quiet           Only errors are displayed. All other output is suppressed
-n, --no-interaction  Do not ask any interactive question
-v|vv|vvv, --verbose  Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug
completion   Dump the shell completion script
doctor       Check that the environment is ready to run an audit
help         Display help for a command
init         Create the standalone configuration and download the selected provider bridge
self-update  Update the standalone binary to the latest released version
audit:run    [audit] Run AI-powered multi-agent security audit on a Symfony project
auth:remove  Forget the API key stored on this machine
auth:set     Store the provider API key on this machine, in a file only you can read
auth:status  Show which API key an audit would use, without printing it
mcp:serve    Start a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio exposing the auditor as tools
